test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Late Jagjit Singh was a popular composer and a ______ singer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghazal**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghazal Singer:**
 
• A Ghazal singer performs the Ghazal, a form of amatory poem or ode, originating in Arabic poetry.
 
• Ghazals are traditionally expressions of love, loss, and longing. 
 
• Late Jagjit Singh was a popular composer and a Ghazal Singer

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Opera Singer:**
 
• An opera singer performs in a kind of performance in which music has a leading role and the parts are taken by singers.
 
• Opera incorporates many of the elements of spoken theatre, such as acting, scenery, and costumes and sometimes includes dance.
 
• **Rock Singer:**
 
• A rock singer sings rock music, a genre that originated as "rock and roll" in the United States in the 1950s, and developed into a range of different styles in the 1960s and later
 
• The sound of rock often revolves around the electric guitar or acoustic guitar, and it uses a strong back beat laid down by a rhythm section.
 
• **Pop Singer: **
 
• A pop singer performs pop music, a genre of popular music that originated in its modern form during the mid-1950s in the United States and the United Kingdom.
 
• The terms "popular music" and "pop music" are often used interchangeably, although the former describes all music that is popular and includes many disparate styles.
